def test_a_transcript_replaces_the_frame_list_in_the_specification_packet(self):
        (self.folder / "frames/transcript.md").write_text(
            "# Transcript of the frames\n\n## Frame 01 · CAP-greeting.R2 · hola\n\n"
            "````\n$ node greet.js Ana es\nHola, Ana! TRANSCRIPT-MARK\n````\n")
        make_packets.main(["x", "CH-0001"], root=self.root)
        text = self.packet("specification")
        self.assertIn("TRANSCRIPT-MARK", text)
        self.assertIn("Judge each entry as its frame.", text)
        self.assertNotIn("frames/01.png", text)
        self.assertNotIn("TRANSCRIPT-MARK", self.packet("security"))

def test_a_terminal_recording_writes_a_transcript_of_its_frames(self):
        frames = self.record([{"caption": "CAP-x.R1 · says one", "run": "echo one"},
                              {"caption": "CAP-x.R2 · says two", "run": "echo two"}])
        text = (frames / "transcript.md").read_text()
        self.assertIn("## Frame 01 · CAP-x.R1 · says one", text)
        self.assertIn("$ echo one\none\n", text)
        self.assertIn("## Frame 02 · CAP-x.R2 · says two", text)
        self.assertIn("$ echo two\ntwo\n", text)
